stable_requirements.fact: Current documented per-file/attempt limits do not describe total database footprint.
stable_requirements.problem: Operator lacks a safe small capacity inventory before selecting a future quota policy.
stable_requirements.proposal: Provide bounded read-only counts of six known record kinds/projects and measured managed relation/database physical bytes, with no document, source, auth or session contents.
stable_requirements.acceptance: Fixed scope/identifiers, independent manual synthetic counts, unknown kinds refused, no sensitive fields.

stable_requirements.fact: Physical database bytes exclude important host and recovery storage.
stable_requirements.problem: A plausible number could be misread as quota consumption or available disk.
stable_requirements.proposal: User output/recipe must explicitly say physical database measurement, not quota; excludes WAL, other databases, backups and filesystem free space. Managed relation sizes and total DB size are overlapping scopes, not numbers to add.
stable_requirements.acceptance: No quota enforcement, global storage certification, backup capacity or free-space claim.

stable_requirements.fact: READ ONLY repeatable read protects logical reads but physical file sizes may still change while PostgreSQL runs.
stable_requirements.problem: Operator may infer atomic simultaneous physical-size/accounting consistency from the word snapshot.
stable_requirements.proposal: Label logical counts as transaction-visible and physical byte values as observations during report execution; include observation time and do not imply repeatable-read freezes on-disk growth.
stable_requirements.acceptance: No exact sum or globally atomic physical snapshot claim; measured values are reported honestly.

stable_requirements.fact: An error may occur after a JSON row is printed but before transaction completion.
stable_requirements.problem: Partial or timed-out output can resemble a valid empty or complete report.
stable_requirements.proposal: Success requires exactly one typed JSON row, explicit completion marker after COMMIT and native exit0. Missing marker/nonzero means incomplete; keep partial file for diagnosis rather than accepting it.
stable_requirements.acceptance: Real same-session read-only write refusal/sentinel unchanged, ready-marked real lock timeout, bad-schema/unknown-kind refusal, bounded no completion marker cases.
